{{Quote|It is he ''[the Fanged God]'' who gifts us with the blood trail, a technique in which you place a drop of your own blood on your target and use that link to track your quarry across the stars.|Mother Talzin, in ''Wild Power''|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
A '''blood trail''' was a [[Force power/Legends|technique]] developed by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They believed it was the domain of their [[Son/Legends|Fanged God]], who governed hunting and was an embodiment of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darkness]], and with this technique, the Nightsister would use her own [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to mark her target.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

[[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] claimed in her ''[[Wild Power]]'' writings that the technique was known only to the Nightsisters. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used this technique to hunt down the defeated [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] even after they had surrendered their thrones to her. Ventress later wrote of her use of the blood trail in ''Wild Power'', and the writings came into the possession of of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who compiled it into the ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

[[Darth Caedus]] used this Force technique on his sister, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] during the [[Second Battle of Roche]] in [[41 ABY]], with the intent that it would lead him to the hidden [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shedu Maad|base]]. It was noted by Jaina as feeling acidic.<ref name="Invincible" /> Later, by [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had also learned this technique; he used it to track the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] after their [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|duel]] on [[Sinkhole Station]]. Skywalker eventually tracked Khai to Dathomir.<ref name="Backlash" />
